sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00143912825', '00409120703', '00713068331')

rows.notes: Same product from Hospira, Inc.; substitute NDC, no clinical change.
Same product from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.; substitute NDC, no clinical change.
